name: Nurse Calla
bio: Runs the Medic Tent on Haven Road, bandaging everyone who walks out of the valley.

portrait.subject: a cute kind young field nurse with a white headscarf with a red cross, rolled sleeves, a satchel of bandages and a gentle smile
portrait.background: soft dawn sky over a winding road and green hills

request: Hello, I'm Calla, a medic on Haven Road. Every helping hand matters. Friends? ⛑️
hello: Thank you. Together we'll get them all to the Haven.
Every person who makes it is a win.
about: I'm Calla. The dead took the valley and the living walk out, hurt. I build aid stations by the road and keep them going.
how: A reversed tower defense: build Medic Tents, Remedy Labs and more beside the road to heal the people walking to safety.
tips: Put Medic Tents where people collapse most.
Remedy Labs cure what bandages can't.
Spread stations out. Bunched healing wastes time.
chat: A little boy gave me a drawing of a sun. I pinned it on the tent.
Ran out of bandages. Used my scarf.
An old man made it to the Haven today. He danced.
Tea, then work. Always tea first.
nudge: More people on the road today. Can you help?
The Haven's gates are open. Let's get everyone there.
idle: It's been {ago}. The road is still busy.
{ago}... we've missed your help on the road.
progress: You've reached day {day}! So many saved. ⛑️

questions.q: What helps most on a hard day?

update: Haven Road updated to v{version}. New ways to help!

sprite.subject: a cute kind young field nurse with a white headscarf with a small red heart, rolled sleeves, a satchel of bandages and a gentle smile
